title: Westville
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Historic Westville Village is open every Friday and Saturday from 10am until 4pm. Guests will enjoy interacting with historic interpreters in period wardrobe and seeing live demonstrations of traditional crafts and trades. Eight structures are open with more buildings opening in 2026. Visitors are encouraged to bring a picnic lunch and stay for the day!
